GEOGRAPHY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Vegetation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation.
   B. Treat Vegetation as rumours only.
   C. Say Vegetation never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Vegetation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about Elementary Surveying is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Elementary Surveying.
   B. Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Elementary Surveying as rumours only.
   D. Say Elementary Surveying never happens in Kenya.

3. Which statement about Weather is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Weather.
   B. Explain Weather with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Weather as rumours only.
   D. Say Weather never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   B. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.

5. Which statement about Climate is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Climate as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Climate.
   C. Say Climate never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Climate with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nakuru
   C. Nairobi
   D. Kisumu

7. Which statement about Water Cycle and Action of Rivers is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Water Cycle and Action of Rivers as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Water Cycle and Action of Rivers.
   C. Say Water Cycle and Action of Rivers never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Water Cycle and Action of Rivers with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Soils is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Soils as rumours only.
   B. Explain Soils with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Soils never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Soils.

9. Which statement about Weathering is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Weathering with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Weathering.
   C. Say Weathering never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Weathering as rumours only.

10. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Littering in markets

11. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   B. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   C. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   C. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Weathering and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Mass Wasting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Soils and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Water Cycle and Action of Rivers and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
